children: Carlon Jonathan Winant, a Director, reported a sale of Class A Common Stock at a weighted average price of $31.1519 per share. The total sale amount reported was $1,557,595. The reporting person directly disposed of 50,000 shares in the transaction dated 2026-09-14. Following the reported transaction, the reporting person directly owns 603,500 Class A Common Stock and indirectly owns 5,110,000 Class A Common Stock via family and irrevocable trusts.
